rationale: All three blocking findings from the final round are resolved by the fix-up commit. CR-001 (critical deadlock): threading.Lock() changed to threading.RLock() at workflow_execution_service.py:48 with a regression test that would deadlock under Lock(). CR-002 (serialization fallback): try/except added around serialize_state/check_state_size in _check_for_interruption; raise InterruptedException is unconditionally outside the try block with checkpoint_state=None on failure; regression test added. CR-003 (test class rename): TestTransitionViewerNoLongerFalseTerminalOnInterrupt renamed to TestTransitionViewerReportsFalseTerminalOnInterrupt. Fix-up diff is 4 files, ~50 lines of focused mechanical changes. No new high-risk issues introduced.

finding_status.notes: threading.Lock() changed to threading.RLock() at workflow_execution_service.py:48. TestWorkflowExecutionLockReentrant::test_record_transition_does_not_deadlock_inside_lock provides a regression test that would deadlock under the original Lock() and passes after the fix.

try/except Exception block wraps check_state_size(serialize_state(...)) in _check_for_interruption; on exception, serialized_checkpoint=None. The raise InterruptedException is unconditionally outside the try block so interrupt semantics are always preserved.
